# PROCESS — what I did this iteration (explainability; REQUIRED)

Seed iteration (cand_0001). No prior iterations to build on. All 10 tasks scored 0 at
baseline: 9 controllable always-failing clusters + 1 infra-errored (pdf-excel-diff, ignored).

## Ranked issue list (clusters by # failing tasks × trials, biggest first)
| rank | cluster | tasks | shared root cause | tag | planned change class |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Agent operates in ADVICE MODE / never runs code / never verifies the output file exists | reserves-at-risk-calc, weighted-gdp-calc, exceltable-in-ppt, offer-letter-generator | mid-tier reader emits a script or "you can run…" and stops; graded file never written; formulas never recalc'd | BEHAVIORAL | Explicit unmissable **Execution contract** at TOP of every relevant SKILL.md + bundled self-verifying scripts that produce the file |
| 2 | Formulas written but never recalculated ("it calculates when opened") | weighted-gdp-calc, reserves-at-risk-calc | openpyxl saves formula text with no cached value → verifier reads None | BEHAVIORAL/KNOWLEDGE | Mandatory `python3 recalc.py` step, `total_errors==0` + non-empty target-cell post-check; `python`→`python3` fixed everywhere |
| 3 | "Pivot table" produced as flat groupby cells, not a real PivotTable object | sales-pivot-analysis | verifier reads `ws._pivots[0]`; pandas pivot has no pivot object; also inner-join drops source rows | CAPABILITY-GAP | NEW tool `xlsx/scripts/create_pivot.py` (`add_pivot_table`) + join-preservation prose |
| 4 | Template placeholders left unfilled; nested-table / header cells missed; no verify | offer-letter-generator | split-run `{{...}}`, nested tables & headers not traversed; "assume success" | CAPABILITY-GAP | NEW tool `docx/scripts/fill_template.py` (split-run-safe, recurses nested tables + all headers/footers, self-verifies zero placeholders remain) |
| 5 | Missing-value recovery guessed instead of derived | xlsx-recover-data | needs Total−Σcomponents, cross-sheet YoY/shares for ≥2 unknowns, all sheets scanned | KNOWLEDGE | Explicit recovery procedure + "process ALL sheets / no `???` left" rule |
| 6 | Record matching too strict/loose (raw string compare) | invoice-fraud-detection | "Ltd"≠"Limited", IBAN spacing, float rounding → false pos/neg | CAPABILITY-GAP | NEW tool `xlsx/scripts/reconcile.py` (suffix-canonical fuzzy match, id norm, tolerant amount compare) |
| 7 | Wrong quantity computed because background rules not read | financial-modeling-qa | definition of the metric lives in a background.pdf the agent skipped | KNOWLEDGE | "Read the supplied context/rules doc FIRST, derive exact definition" rule + example |
| 8 | Embedded Excel in pptx not edited in place / formulas clobbered / file not written | exceltable-in-ppt | must rewrite only `ppt/embeddings/*.xlsx` ZIP entry, preserve formula cells | CAPABILITY-GAP | NEW reference `pptx/embedded_objects.md` worked example + SKILL.md pointer |
| 9 | pptx formatting: literal "1." bullets, box moved instead of paragraph centered, wrong title shape | pptx-reference-formatting | buChar vs buAutoNum; center = paragraph algn not shape position | RULE-VIOLATION/CAPABILITY-GAP | `pptx/scripts/replace.py` emits `<a:buAutoNum>` on `numbered`/`bullet_type`; SKILL.md editing rules |

## Changes made this iteration (one row per edit)
| cluster | edit class | file / tool | what & why it generalizes | protects passing? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1,2,5,7 + all xlsx | prompt: role/contract + procedures | xlsx/SKILL.md | Added top Execution contract (produce file yourself, exact path, python3, mandatory recalc, verify), read-rules-first, join preservation, missing-value recovery, real-pivot, reconcile; `python recalc.py`→`python3`; description keywords | 0 passing tasks; additive knowledge only |
| 4 | NEW composite tool | docx/scripts/fill_template.py | Split-run-safe {{placeholder}} + conditional filler; recurses nested tables + all 6 header/footer types; self-verifies zero placeholders remain, exits non-zero otherwise | additive script; no existing behavior touched |
| 4 | prompt: contract + trigger | docx/SKILL.md | "Do this first: run the bundled filler then verify" + Execution contract; description trigger keywords | additive |
| 3 | NEW compute tool | xlsx/scripts/create_pivot.py | `add_pivot_table()` builds a genuine PivotTable readable via `ws._pivots[0]` (row field + dataField subtotal + cache) | additive script |
| 6 | NEW compute tool | xlsx/scripts/reconcile.py | canonical_name / match_name / norm_id / amounts_equal — suffix-aware fuzzy vendor match, tolerant id/amount compare | additive script |
| 8 | NEW reference | pptx/embedded_objects.md | Worked example: edit `ppt/embeddings/*.xlsx` in place, preserve formula cells, rewrite only that ZIP entry | additive reference |
| 9 | tool CODE + prompt | pptx/scripts/replace.py + pptx/SKILL.md | Bullet branch emits `<a:buAutoNum type=...>` when `numbered`/`bullet_type`/`bullet_char` present (else unchanged buChar); SKILL.md center=paragraph-alignment, buAutoNum, title-shape selection, embedded-object pointer | code path fires ONLY on new JSON props → default bullet behavior byte-identical |

## Verify-the-fix (trace → what the change now does on those exact inputs)
- docx/fill_template.py: ran on a synthetic template with split-run `{{name}}`, a nested-table cell `{{salary}}`, and a header `{{company}}` → all filled, self-scan reports 0 remaining `{{...}}`, exit 0. Empty-value/absent-key path leaves no stray braces. Blast radius: brand-new script, nothing else imports it.
- pptx/replace.py: JSON with `"numbered": true` → produced `<a:buAutoNum type="arabicPeriod"/>`; JSON WITHOUT those keys → output XML byte-identical to pre-edit (buChar branch untouched). So only the previously-failing numbered-list path changes.
- xlsx/create_pivot.py: built pivot on sample data → reload shows `rowfield: STATE`, `data: [('Sum of POPULATION','sum')]`; round-trip save/load preserves it; second pivot with agg="count" → `[('Count of EARNERS','count')]`. Matches the `_pivots[0]` row-field + aggregation the verifier reads.
- xlsx/reconcile.py: `is_same_vendor("Acme Ltd","Acme Limited")`=True; different vendor=False; `norm_id` IBAN with/without spaces equal=True; `amounts_equal(100.0,100.004)`=True. Neither over- nor under-flags.
- xlsx/SKILL.md recalc mandate: targets weighted-gdp/reserves traces where formulas stayed uncached; contract now forces `python3 recalc.py` + `total_errors==0` + non-empty target check. Knowledge/behavioral prose; 0 passing tasks to regress.
- Blast-radius summary: 0 tasks currently pass, so no passing behavior exists to change; every script edit is additive and every prompt edit is additive knowledge (no decision/permission rule loosened).

## Process & features used
- Subagents: 5 parallel read-only diagnosis subagents (one per trajectory group) to cluster all 9 failures by shared root cause; edits then authored serially and merged into this one candidate.
- Prior iterations: none — this is the seed (RUNMAP/prior_iterations empty). LEDGER/JOURNAL had no RESULT lines to build on.

## Good things to PRESERVE (do not let a future iteration undo these)
- The three bundled scripts (fill_template.py, create_pivot.py, reconcile.py) and the embedded_objects.md reference — each closes a hard-zero capability gap and is verified.
- The "Execution contract" block at the top of each SKILL.md — it is the fix for the dominant advice-mode/never-verify failure; do not soften "produce the file yourself" or the mandatory-recalc step.
- pptx replace.py buAutoNum branch is gated on new JSON props — keep it additive; do not make numbering the default.

## Deliberately skipped (cluster + why)
- pdf-excel-diff — flagged as uncontrollable infrastructure error (aborted trials, ~0 mean); no edit can fix it, so pdf/SKILL.md was NOT touched (editing it would fail the REAL test — no failing pdf capability cluster exists).
